diagram_previews.alt: A circle centred at O, shaded grey, containing three blue semicircles of radius 1 whose diameters' endpoints lie on the circle; the semicircles bulge inward and touch one another, and their unshaded interiors are white. A red dashed equilateral triangle joins the semicircles' centres. A dashed radius from O to an endpoint is labelled R, and one half-diameter is labelled 1.
